lines.text: LC Connect. Your laser-components lead database, answered in plain English, right inside ChatGPT.
Just ask. Here's the big picture: every lead, broken down by industry, as a live chart.
Drill into a sector, like defense electronics, and it returns the actual companies. Real, structured data, not a wall of text.
Ask about a single company, and it pulls together everything on file.
And see exactly where your leads are, across Europe.
Installing it takes about two minutes.
In ChatGPT, open Settings, go to Apps, and create a new app.
Give it a name, paste the connector's address, and click Create. That's it, you're connected.
LC Connect. Find and enrich your leads, in plain English. Try it yourself.
